findings.title: Frozen Stage-A gate INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE cannot fire for either selected family as frozen at W3

evidence.plan: PLAN_forex_v3.md section 12 lists 'overall incremental alpha > 0 vs the frozen benchmark treatment' as a mandatory Stage-A gate; 'Positive raw PnL never overrides failed incremental alpha'
evidence.runner: research/assets/forex_free_v3/scored_runner.py lines 540-542: gate fires only `if alpha is not None`; alpha comes solely from meta (line 509: meta.get("incremental_alpha"))
evidence.families: family1.py meta (lines 487-508) supplies NO incremental_alpha; family2.py meta (lines 672-735) supplies NO incremental_alpha; repo-wide grep finds no module computing it
evidence.handoffs: i_runner.json documents it as family-supplied meta; neither family handoff discloses a deferral for it

findings.impact: If Phase E ran as frozen, a cell could pass all other gates and be declared a Stage-A survivor without the cycle's central incremental-information test ever being evaluated. Unresolved: no owner, no injection point.

findings.title: Frozen USD-drift diagnostic gate (usd_corr_abs_ceiling 0.3) cannot fire for either selected family as frozen at W3

evidence.plan: PLAN_forex_v3.md section 12: 'USD-drift diagnostic within the frozen bound (inherited from V2)'
evidence.runner: scored_runner.py line 478 consumes meta.get("usd_index_daily_returns") or {}; with absent/None input usd_drift_corr returns evaluated=False and the gate cannot fire (by design 'cannot fail' below 60 days)
evidence.family1: family1.py meta supplies NO usd_index_daily_returns key at all (no disclosure)
evidence.family2: family2.py line 730 supplies usd_index_daily_returns=None with usd_index_note deferring to 'scoring integration'; handoff i_family2.json line 75 says 'A7 scoring integration must supply it' and next_action says 'supply meta.usd_index_daily_returns ... at scoring time'
evidence.blocking_fact: No injection point exists in frozen code: exec_driver passes family meta verbatim to stage_a_gates; the runner only reads family meta. Supplying it requires a post-freeze code change to family1.py/family2.py or scored_runner.py, which invalidates all seven verified W3 code_hashes and requires a new freeze. No such lane exists between S0 authorization and Phase E.

findings.impact: A USD-carrying book (all 7 universe pairs involve USD) could pass Stage A with the inherited USD-drift bound never evaluated. Unresolved at authorization time.

findings.title: Dummy dry-run records leak real outcome information (stress-tier PnL and break-even bps) despite scored=false/real_pnl=false

evidence.contract: scored_runner.py line 513 comment: 'Dry-run placeholders: no scored metric may leave this module'; exec_driver.py: dummy mode 'Reveals no outcome'; PLAN section 10 mandates the dry-run as a PRE-authorization step
evidence.code: compute_cell calls stress_book(specs,...) with REAL TradeSpecs in dry-run (scored_runner.py lines 479-481); accounting.book_stress books real prices at every tier and is not zeroed by the dry-run branch (lines 514-519 zero only the four top-level book columns); break_even_cost_bps (line 503) uses _gross_move_pnl which is never zeroed
evidence.measured: Auditor re-ran family2:causal_negative_control with freeze_token=None: record carries scored=False real_pnl=False yet stress tier1.0 total_pnl=-644.1209630929 USD / expectancy=-5.8029 / pf=0.9300, tier1.5 total_pnl=-810.6209630929, tier2.0 total_pnl=-977.1209630929, and break_even_cost_bps=-1.401446 (signed, gross-edge-derived)
evidence.mitigation_observed: The W3 freeze dry-run artifact recorded only counts (no leak persisted in the control plane), and exec_driver's dummy report persists only cell_id/gate flags; the leak is in the compute_cell return value any operator may dump (PLAN section 10 itself says dry-run 'into a temporary ledger')

findings.impact: The mandated pre-authorization dry-run reveals arm-level profitability direction (including the anchor arms) to anyone handling its records, contaminating the outcome-blindness the S0 authorization depends on. Contract self-contradiction inside the frozen module.

findings.title: Drop-one FOLD survival is not computed or gated; only drop-one PAIR survival is enforced

evidence.baseline: baseline_invariants.json v3_sample_floors.min_meaningful_drop_one: 'drop-one pair AND drop-one fold survival per inherited dropout_survival_min_of_7'; PLAN section 12: 'meaningful drop-one pair and fold survival'
evidence.runner: compute_cell drop_one_expectancy iterates PAIRS only (scored_runner.py lines 473-476); stage_a_gates checks DROP_ONE_PAIR_SURVIVAL_INSUFFICIENT only; no fold-exclusion statistic exists anywhere in the module

findings.impact: One of the frozen sample-floor components cannot fail. Fold concentration (e.g., all profit in one fold) is only partially caught by the fold-positive-share and fold-PF gates.

findings.title: Per-arm timeout cannot actually stop a hung family worker thread

evidence.runner: call_family_arm (scored_runner.py lines 585-610) joins a daemon thread for timeout_minutes; on expiry it raises TechAbort fail-closed and discards results, but the worker thread itself keeps running (threads cannot be killed), continuing to consume CPU/RAM against the 8GB shared-machine resource contract

findings.impact: Fail-closed for results (no scored metric escapes); residual resource use only. Acceptable for a serial single-lane contract; noted for the record.
